The 0.09% drawdown from the 30-minute high is too shallow to read as a clean entry.

If the desk insists on buying anyway: $5 ticket (the smallest size, given a 682 SOL pool and thin recent flow), 20% hard stop, 15-minute max hold. Fees of 1.4-5.1% plus the 30-second delay make a quick scalp hard to win.

Refuse if the operator wallets are still net buyers at entry, if the pool drops below roughly 300 SOL, or if the 30-second latency could push fills well past the decision price.
